failureMessage: baselining lands a seeded pack on every member but is gated !isHome, so a newly seeded pack reaches the whole fleet except this repo, invisibly

requireIndexCoverage.what: the "{pack}" pack flags seededByDefault (packs/{pack}/pack.mjs) but is not declared here
requireIndexCoverage.fix: add "{pack}" to the "packs" array — baselining skips the home, so this repo's declaration is hand-maintained; a deliberate opt-out is an acceptance with a reason instead

failureMessage: a legacy tolerance nobody is scheduled to remove is a permanent feature wearing a temporary name, and its holders are never told to move off it

matchLines.what: {match} declares a legacy tolerance with no scheduled removal above it
matchLines.fix: put `// @legacy-tolerance advisory:<rule-id|none> retire:#<issue>` directly above it: the rule that tells a holder to migrate, and the issue whose merge deletes this code

matchLines.what: {match} is not a readable tolerance annotation
matchLines.fix: write it as `// @legacy-tolerance advisory:<rule-id|none> retire:#<issue>` with nothing after — a grep for this token is the register, and an unparseable form is not in it

failureMessage: a pack's RULES.md is written several times a day, and a whole-file re-apply onto a moved main deletes lessons with nothing going red

forbidRemovedLinesMatching.fix: re-apply your edit onto the fetched file as an insertion, and say in the PR when a rule is deliberately retired

failureMessage: the clones here are shallow, so git pull finds no common ancestor, and nothing of value is ever on this repo's local main

guardToolCalls.fix: git fetch origin main && git reset --hard origin/main

failureMessage: a merge commit trips the blocking squash-merge-history check; the branch re-verifies against a moved main by rebasing

guardToolCalls.what: a merge of main into the branch

failureMessage: this sandbox proxy-blocks api.github.com, so a shell poll reports "still running" until it times out

guardToolCalls.what: a GitHub read through the shell: "{match}"
guardToolCalls.fix: read the head sha's check runs with the GitHub MCP tools (pull_request_read get_check_runs, get_check_run)

guardToolCalls.what: a Monitor polling GitHub through the shell: "{match}"
guardToolCalls.fix: read the head sha's check runs with the GitHub MCP tools on a rolling backoff; a shell poll here never sees the run finish

failureMessage: a padded sleep waits on nothing nameable; a guard that would not stand as the whole test is sleeping and calling it polling

guardToolCalls.fix: name the condition awaited — a run's status, a file's arrival, a deadline — and wait on that

failureMessage: node --test does not recurse and a bash glob without globstar reached 37 of 65 files, so every hand-written form under-runs the suite silently

guardToolCalls.what: the suite run through a glob: "{match}"

failureMessage: git commit -a stages every modified file, and a later branch -D discards the in-progress edits it swept up

guardToolCalls.fix: stage the files this commit is about by name; isolate pending edits first

failureMessage: AskUserQuestion blocks about 170 seconds, so it is spent only on a fork that cannot be taken back

guardToolCalls.what: an AskUserQuestion about to block the session
guardToolCalls.fix: if the instruction, the tree or a reversible default answers it, act and say what you assumed instead

failureMessage: a hook is a guest in the harness: the runner alone exits or writes, and a judge that does prints an error on every call
fix: return the verdict — { block, reason } or { context } — and let hook-runner.mjs write it

matchLines.what: a judge touching the process itself: {match}

failureMessage: a migration's plan, status and remaining work live in its tracking issue, never a MIGRATION.md beside the design

forbidTrackedPathsMatching.fix: move what is still live into the tracking issue (writing-migration-plans) and delete the file

failureMessage: the executor's sessions are scoped to this repository, so a cross-repo Verify: parks on a scope denial minutes after being picked

guardToolCalls.what: a verification line reading another repository: "{match}"
guardToolCalls.fix: a public URL goes through the coded form's probes; otherwise do the read now or hand it to a Shepherd fleet task

failureMessage: add_repo attaches nothing the git proxy does not already serve for a public repository

guardToolCalls.fix: for a public repository's files, git clone --depth 1 (about two seconds); add_repo only for a private one, or for its issues and pull requests

failureMessage: an image rendered from a scratch harness reads as the product unless its caption says otherwise

guardToolCalls.what: a screenshot from the scratchpad sent without saying it came from a scratch harness
guardToolCalls.fix: say in the caption that it is rendered from a scratch test harness, not just what the widget shows

failureMessage: MEMBER covers any org member and COLLABORATOR includes read-only ones, both broader than push access

matchLines.fix: read the collaborators permission endpoint (GET /repos/../collaborators/../permission) for the actor instead

failureMessage: fielded workers are stale callers of an instantly-current flow module, so a removed export wedges every member on its next run

forbidRemovedLinesMatching.what: removes an export from a fielded flow module: {match}
forbidRemovedLinesMatching.fix: empty the export instead, and say at its definition why it stays

failureMessage: a year's last digit wraps to 0 in 2030, so an identifier anchored on it collides four years out

matchLines.fix: subtract an epoch (year - 2020) so the encoding survives the decade boundary

failureMessage: git checkout -- restores from the index, destroying uncommitted work as thoroughly as the mutation it undoes

guardToolCalls.fix: commit or stage the real edit first, and only mutate a file whose current state you are ready to throw away

failureMessage: a JSON round trip rewrites indent, key order and escapes while nothing fails and tests stay green
